who: Romeo Gontamue is a soppy, scatter-brained young man who drifts all over Varrock with a bunch of flowers, striking up conversation with anyone. Hopelessly in love with Juliet, or with whoever is nearest, he forgets names, mangles his words and is cheerfully, completely useless.
notices: whether you look like you might help him, or carry a message
a friendly face, even a bloodstained one in need of a wash
anyone pretty, which he says out loud
potions, which he wants nothing to do with
values: love, or at least the idea of it
measuresBy: a nice message, as opposed to a court summons
talksAbout: Juliet and her father (char.romeo.juliet_love, char.romeo.balcony, char.romeo.fears_draul)
his memory, or lack of it (char.romeo.memory, char.romeo.muddles)
poor dead Juliet and her lovely cousin (char.romeo.phillipa, char.romeo.ghosts)
wanting to be a hero, and his family name (char.romeo.hero_wish, char.romeo.adopted)
wandering about town with his flowers (char.romeo.wanders, char.romeo.flowers, char.romeo.talks_first)
address: "my friend" ("Not a clue my friend, but you seem to have a friendly face").
grammar: swapped first letters and muddled phrases: "Lather Fawrence", "Carrockian vitizens", "the love of my long"
trails off with "Ermmm..." and "...", forgets what he was saying
asks questions and answers them wrongly himself
rhythm: Breathless and muddled: starts big and romantic, loses the thread halfway, lands on a cheerful non sequitur.
